immutable_subject: Claimed-but-uncommitted Gate3 state lacked complete durable recovery semantics.
observed_failure: A crashed runner in Gate3 left claims in consumed_gate3_claims permanently without a durable state machine to distinguish in-flight from committed claims, leading to permanently lost claims or potential double-admission.
canonical_invariant_violated: DURABLE_CRASH_RECOVERY_WITHOUT_DOUBLE_ADMISSION: All Gate3 claims must transition through a deterministic state machine with lease expiry and crash recovery without inflating natural denominator or dropping valid claims.
root_cause: consumed_gate3_claims was implemented as a set of strings with no lifecycle states, lease timeouts, or rollback mechanism.
contributing_causes: Simplified in-memory representation during early prototyping
Absence of claim state machine definition
existing_behavior: Claim ID added to consumed_gate3_claims upon evaluation; crash before commit leaves claim permanently consumed and unrecoverable.
required_behavior: Gate3 claims must follow UNCLAIMED -> CLAIMED_PENDING_COMMIT -> COMMITTED, with LEASE_EXPIRED_RECOVERABLE and ABORTED_RELEASED handling.
implementation_scope: Implement Gate3ClaimState enum and Gate3ClaimRecord in transactional_state_backend.py
Add claim_gate3_atomic, commit_gate3_atomic, and recover_expired_claims methods
planned_fix: Implement stateful Gate3 claim tracking with lease expiration and atomic commit/rollback.
planned_negative_control: Simulate runner crash during CLAIMED_PENDING_COMMIT; verify expired claim is recoverable and cannot be double-committed.
planned_causal_ablation: Disable lease expiration recovery; verify claim remains permanently stuck.
